svg.title: Moirai — the instruments of fate
svg.desc: Clotho spins a continuous thread, Lachesis measures it with dividers, and Atropos cuts it with shears. One aligned constellation and an interrupted measured thread connect the three instruments. Clotho is published beta 0.3.0b6; Lachesis is planned; Atropos is an existing skill pack. Symbolic identity art, not a scientific diagram or capability claim.
